purpose: Independent practice of C3.1 with loops.
student_learning_goal: I can use a loop in my code to repeat steps.

header.student_learning_goal_banner: I can use a loop in my code to repeat steps.
header.character_watermark: Looper the Loop Helper in the top-right corner. Small (~1.5in tall).

parts.part_title: Part 1: Long Code to Loop Code
parts.student_instructions: Each long code can be written shorter using a loop. Write the loop version.

image_placeholders.description: Four code-conversion rows in B&W line-art, stacked. Each ~7in × 1in. Format: long code on left (e.g., 'right, right, right'), arrow, blank loop slot on right ('Repeat ___: ___'). Long codes: 3 rights; 4 ups; 5 forwards; 6 turn rights.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS02_P1_FOUR_CONVERSIONS: keywords (loop) name what the rows ask for.

parts.answer_key: Repeat 3: right. Repeat 4: up. Repeat 5: forward. Repeat 6: turn right.

parts.student_instructions: Write loop code to draw each shape. Use Repeat N: forward, turn.
parts.visual_layout: Middle. Three shape boxes (square, triangle, hexagon).

image_placeholders.description: Three shape boxes in B&W line-art, stacked. Each ~7in × 1.5in. Each shows a shape name (Square, Triangle, Hexagon) plus a blank code line.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS02_P2_THREE_SHAPES: keywords (shape, loop) name what the boxes ask for.

parts.answer_key: Square: Repeat 4: forward, turn. Triangle: Repeat 3: forward, turn. Hexagon: Repeat 6: forward, turn.

parts.student_instructions: Invent your own loop. Write what it draws or does.
parts.visual_layout: Bottom. A blank box with thinking-bubble icon.

image_placeholders.description: A blank box in B&W line-art, ~7in × 2in. Top: 'My loop: ___'. Below: 'What it does: ___'. Looper thinking-bubble icon top-right.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS02_P3_MY_LOOP: keywords (loop) name what the box asks for.

early_finisher_prompt: If you finish, write a loop to draw an octagon.
teacher_notes: Lesson 2 consolidation. Watch for loop-as-list errors (Repeat 1 multiple times) — flag for compression reteach.
